title: Hinged arm
summary: A rotating arm on a fixed base with a 240° hinge travel.
script:
import cadquery as cq

base = cq.Workplane("XY").box(42, 32, 6, centered=(True, True, False))
base = base.union(cq.Workplane("XY").circle(4).extrude(16))
arm = cq.Workplane("XY").box(50, 12, 5).translate((20, 0, 10))
arm = arm.cut(cq.Workplane("XY").circle(4.2).extrude(18))
result = cq.Assembly(name="Hinged arm")
result.add(base, name="Base", metadata={"lad_id": "base"})
result.add(arm, name="Arm", color=cq.Color(0.18, 0.42, 0.75), metadata={"lad_id": "arm"})
result.metadata["lad_motion"] = {
    "grounded": ["base"],
    "connectors": [
        {"id": "base-pivot", "part": "base", "origin": [0, 0, 10]},
        {"id": "arm-pivot", "part": "arm", "origin": [0, 0, 10]},
    ],
    "joints": [
        {"id": "hinge", "name": "Arm angle", "type": "revolute",
         "parent": "base-pivot", "child": "arm-pivot", "limits": [-120, 120]},
    ],
}
